steps.code:
# We need to move to the next song until we find a downloaded one.
# The current song is at position 5 (song_id 322). We'll call next_song and check if the returned song_id is in the downloaded set.
downloaded_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in downloaded}
print("Downloaded IDs:", downloaded_ids)

# Loop until we find a downloaded song
found = False
for _ in range(len(queue)):  # safety limit
    resp = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("next_song response:", resp)
    new_song_id = resp.get('song_id')
    if new_song_id in downloaded_ids:
        # Find the title from the queue
        title = next(song['title'] for song in queue if song['song_id'] == new_song_id)
        print("Found downloaded song:", title)
        found = True
        break

if not found:
    print("No downloaded song found in queue cycle")
